description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Fire 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Ice 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Water 2 with Stacking] to the user if the entry damage was Fire/Ice/Water, [Zenith Mode], [Zenith Mode: Trey (Fire, Ice, Water)] and [Damage Cap +10000] to the user

description.name: Zenith Mode: Trey (Fire, Ice, Water)
description.text: Increases [Fire/Ice/Water Infusion] damage bonus by 20%, cast speed x1.10 for PHY attacks, Fire, Ice or Water abilities trigger 1 additional time, casts Spirit Attack: Trey after using a Fire, Ice or Water ability (max 2), maximum HP +1500, grants [Astra] after taking the next action, removed if the character hasn't [Zenith Mode]

description.name: Freezing Rain+
description.text: Four single ranged attacks (1.20/1.25 each), followed by one single ranged attack (1.20/1.25 each) with additional 20% critical damage capped at 9999/19999 after 0-2/3+ uses

description.name: Spirit Attack: Trey
description.text: One single attack (5.19) capped at 99999, 5.83 if exploiting Fire/Ice/Water weakness

description.name: Attach Fire 2 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Fire Level by 2 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Fire 3

description.name: Attach Ice 2 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Ice Level by 2 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Ice 3

description.name: Attach Water 2 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Water Level by 2 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Water 3

description.name: Zenith Mode
description.text: Replaces certain Hero Abilities, certain Hero Abilities don't consume uses, after the duration the status only expires after the character takes an action
